query: What methods are available for reporting domestic violence?
reference_answer:
Reporting Domestic Violence:
To report domestic violence, call the Tamil Nadu Police helpline (1091) or visit your local police station. You can also contact the National Domestic Violence Helpline (181). Provide details of the incident, and the police will guide you through the process.
answer: Methods for reporting domestic violence include contacting local police, seeking help from domestic violence shelters, and contacting support hotlines such as the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-SAFE (7233). [Document 1]
